reason: Continue implementation of the selected acceptance item until criteria pass.
criteria: Only app.py, health.py, problems.py, middleware.py, log.py under api/src/dogwatch_api and test_health.py, test_openapi.py, test_problems.py, test_request_context.py under api/tests are created; pyproject.toml, uv.lock and settings.py are unchanged.

IC-3.1/IC-3.2/INV-P6: `GET /api/v1/health` returns 200 with the DC-5 body exactly; `/api/v1/openapi.json` has `openapi` starting `3.1`, `set(paths) == {"/api/v1/health"}` and a HealthStatus component; `/docs`, `/redoc` and `/api/v1/health/` return 404 (redirect_slashes=False).

INV-P2 error taxonomy: every non-2xx response is `application/problem+json` with keys exactly {type,title,status,detail,code}, status equal to the HTTP status and type `urn:dogwatch:problem:<code>`; tested codes are 404 not-found, 405 method-not-allowed (with Allow header), 422 validation-failed (no input echoed), 500 internal-error; reserved constants schema-invalid 400, in-flight 409, payload-too-large 413, idempotency-conflict 422 and rate-limited 429 exist in problems.py with no route using them.
422 and 500 paths are exercised only via test-only routes registered on a create_app() instance inside tests; the product app exposes no route beyond health and openapi (FR-043).

INV-P1: each request gets an X-Request-ID response header and exactly one DC-7 compact-JSON stdout log line with matching request_id and correct route (template; partial match for 405; null for 404); RequestContext is a pure ASGI outermost middleware.
INV-P3: the 500 body contains neither the exception message nor `Traceback`; its log line has level `error` and a non-empty error_traceback.

INV-P4: an inbound X-Request-ID of `"a"*128` is echoed; `"a"*129`, `x\ny` and `é` are replaced by a UUID4 and the raw value appears in no log line. INV-P5: neither query `token=secret` nor an `Authorization: Bearer x` header appears in any log line.
